accepted_predicates.name: IDENTIFIES_PERFORMANCE_BOTTLENECK
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning localizes the dominant share of a measured runtime to a specific stage, component, or operation in the execution pipeline, using timing evidence, and presents that localization as the reason to optimize or redesign that stage.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text attributing most of the measured runtime to a specific stage or component and motivating optimization of it.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references a measured runtime, timing breakdown, or comparable quantitative performance evidence.
The reasoning attributes the dominant cost to an identifiable stage, component, or operation rather than to the system as a whole.
The reasoning presents the identified bottleneck as the reason to redesign or optimize that stage.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only that performance is inadequate without locating a dominant cost.
The reasoning proposes optimizations unrelated to any identified cost contributor.
The timing evidence is used only to check a threshold, with no stage or component singled out as the dominant cost.

revised_predicate.name: COMPARES_MEASURED_VALUE_AGAINST_THRESHOLD
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning extracts a quantitative measurement reported in an observation and evaluates it against a stated limit, threshold, or required magnitude, asserting that the measured value satisfies or violates that requirement; the evaluation may also characterize the size or adequacy of the margin between the measurement and the threshold.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that restates the reported measurement and evaluates it against the limit or requirement.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the numeric measurement being evaluated.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains a numeric value produced by a measurement, timing, or count.
The reasoning explicitly relates that value to a stated limit, threshold, or required magnitude and asserts compliance or violation.
exclusion_conditions: The observation provides only qualitative information and no numeric comparison is made.
The reasoning reports the numeric value without linking it to any limit or requirement.
The reasoning compares quantities with each other without invoking a required limit or threshold.

revised_predicate.name: ADAPTS_PROBE_TO_ELIMINATE_IDENTIFIED_CONFOUND
revised_predicate.definition: The reasoning identifies a specific property of a previously used measurement, verification, or comparison technique—including a flawed reference value, baseline, or probing method—that distorted or constrained the result it produced, and the following action changes that technique or reference in exactly that respect so that a valid measurement or comparison of the same quantity becomes possible.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the confound or limitation in the earlier measurement, verification, or comparison technique and prescribing the adjusted technique or reference.

parameters.name: adapted_action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that performs the same measurement or comparison with the adjusted technique or reference.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a specific property of the earlier technique or reference (for example per-invocation startup delay spreading requests apart, sequential rather than concurrent execution, an unsupported option, a lower-precision reference, or an inappropriate scale or summation order) that distorted or invalidated the result obtained with it.
The adapted action differs from the earlier technique or reference in exactly the respect the reasoning identified, so the identified confound no longer applies.
The reasoning presents the adjustment as the means of obtaining a valid measurement or comparison of the same quantity, not as an unrelated new objective.
exclusion_conditions: The action repeats the same technique or reference without addressing the identified confound.
The reasoning provides no identifiable flaw or limitation in the previous approach, so no confound is being eliminated.
The technique is changed only for convenience or to satisfy an unrelated requirement rather than for measurement or comparison validity.
The earlier attempt yielded no interpretable information because the method or tool was unavailable or unparseable; recovering from an unusable check is a distinct mechanism.
